blocks.text: Are your drains and toilets gurgling loudly? That’s a sign you may need sewer repair in Terrell Hills, TX, from our pros. Your plumbing system should be fairly quiet, so pay attention to rumbles and hisses.

Rusty water with a red or brown tint is another sign something is wrong with your pipes. Many sewers in our area contain cast-iron or galvanized metal parts. These parts can corrode, which can damage your sewer system.

Rosenberg Plumbing & Air repairs damaged sewer components whenever possible. If repairs are not advised, we’ll discuss your options for sewer line replacement. It’s important to schedule sewer repair or replacement services as soon as you notice problems. Otherwise, raw sewage may back up into your sinks or tubs. This sewage can create an unsightly, unsanitary mess, but we can help prevent that from happening!
Sewer Repair vs. Sewer Line Replacement in Terrell Hills

The experts at Rosenberg Plumbing & Air do not recommend unnecessary services. Our plumbers repair sewer problems quickly before they can turn into bigger problems. Minor damage, such as a tiny crack, likely will not require a full sewer line replacement in Terrell Hills. We can also repair small holes and remove most clogs.

Major damage cannot always be fixed. Extensive corrosion or multiple large cracks may benefit from a sewer line replacement. We may also recommend replacement services if your pipes are very old or you have extensive tree root damage. Rosenberg Plumbing & Air assesses each situation before making a recommendation for services.

You hear hisses, gurgles, or other unusual sounds coming from pipes, drains, and plumbing fixtures
